text: Maaku an Nulaaɗo: min, Allah haɗii lam rewugol, ɗin ɗi rewoton, hara wanaa Allah; sanamuuji ɗi nafataa, ɗi lorrataa. Mi haɗa ɗum, nde hujjaaji ɗin arunoo e am, fii ɓanngingol meere rewugol ɗin. Allah yamiri lam kadi, nde mi jebbilantoo Mo, Kanko tun, ka dewal. Tawde ko Kanko woni Jeyɗo tageefo ngon fow. Jeyɗo ngo alaa, si wanaa Kanko.
